spec.title: Solar Totals by Time Frame
spec.description: This panel uses a user selected PDT offset of 7-8 hours to make the day calculation correct.

spec.query: SELECT cumulative_sum(last("eload_day")) FROM "device_data" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d,$TimeOffset) fill(null)
SELECT cumulative_sum(last("etouser_day")) FROM "device_data" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d,$TimeOffset) fill(null)
SELECT cumulative_sum(last("etogrid_day")) FROM "device_data" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d,$TimeOffset) fill(null)
SELECT cumulative_sum(last("epv1_day")) FROM "device_data" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d,$TimeOffset) fill(null)
SELECT cumulative_sum(last("echg_day")) FROM "device_data" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d,$TimeOffset) fill(null)
SELECT cumulative_sum(last("edischg_day")) FROM "device_data" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d,$TimeOffset) fill(null)
SELECT cumulative_sum(last("einv_day")) FROM "device_data" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d,$TimeOffset) fill(null)
SELECT COUNT("daily_count") FROM (  SELECT COUNT("einv_day") AS "daily_count"  FROM "device_data" WHERE $timeFilter GROUP BY time(1d,$TimeOffset) fill(null))
